note: The five display roles and their INTENDED capability boundaries, from the owner's clarification in #48 (2026-10-15, 10:21 PM ET). These are capability sets, not a numeric ladder. Every capability here is intended, not implemented: nothing in this fixture grants access, and current OWNER/READER/AGENT session enforcement is unchanged until a reviewed migration implements the taxonomy.

capabilities.description: Manages approved studio content within the assigned workspace.
Manages agent configuration within the assigned workspace.
Manages cube settings within the assigned workspace.
Reads permitted audit evidence and test results.
May run explicitly approved checks in disposable test environments.

roles.name: Owner
roles.intendedScope: Owns the cube/workspace and assigns roles; final authority for designated approvals.

roles.name: Administrator
roles.intendedScope: Manages approved studio content, agent configuration and cube settings within the assigned workspace.

roles.name: Operator
roles.intendedScope: Imports approved ideas and runs explicitly permitted workflows; cannot assign roles or change policy.

roles.name: Reader
roles.intendedScope: Reads permitted records, follows citations and inspects the cube; no content writes.

roles.name: CI Auditor
roles.intendedScope: Reads permitted audit evidence and test results; may run explicitly approved checks in disposable test environments, with no studio-content writes or role management.
